name: Mark Cuban Cost Plus Drug Company (online pharmacy)
notes: Tier 2. The catalog also has a roster entry for the same company and site (mark-cuban-cost-plus-drug-company-200211); only this detailed entry gets a dossier. Researched from the public costplusdrugs.com FAQ (expanded in a browser; the site blocks plain fetches). Account menu: Dashboard, Order Status, Health Profile, Shipping, Payments, Insurance, Settings. Payment: once the pharmacy receives the prescription, Cost Plus emails you to check out and pay; a previous payment method can be reused or a new one added at checkout; many FSA/HSA cards work; coupons and discount cards are not accepted; charges may appear as HealthDyne (the fulfillment pharmacy). Payment is card-only (billing.methods card). Auto-refill charges the card used when auto-refill was turned on for that prescription (first order placed manually, email 7 days before processing, cancel up to 7 days before, declined card means a manual order with another card; changing the card means turning auto-refill off and on). It is modelled as the AutoPay page labelled Auto-refill (card only, full amount). Shipping: standard $5.25 (1-2 Rx) to $16 (7+), expedited $15-$25, Alaska/Hawaii expedited $25 flat, cold-chain $55; taxes by state; refunds 5-10 business days; no returns. Pricing is cost plus 15% plus pharmacy labor and shipping. Support is by Contact Us form or email; no customer phone number is published on the pages read, so limitation notes point to Contact Us. No guest payment, payment plan, paperless bill or future-dated payment is described (unsupported, inferred).

autopay.note: Auto-refill charges the card you used when you turned it on for that prescription. You get an email 7 days before each order is processed; to use a different card, turn auto-refill off and back on with a new first order.

guest_pay.note: Checkout needs a Cost Plus Drugs account: once your prescription arrives, we email you to sign in, check out and pay. For help, use the Contact Us form.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not offered; each order is paid in full at checkout. If you have trouble with a payment, contact Customer Support through the Contact Us form.

paperless.note: Cost Plus Drugs does not mail bills. Receipts and order details are in your account under your orders, and notifications come by email.

scheduled_payment.note: Orders are paid at checkout; future-dated payments are not offered.

help.title: Paying for your prescriptions
paragraphs: Once Cost Plus Drugs receives your prescription from your doctor, you get an email asking you to check out and pay. At checkout you can use a payment method you used before or add a new one, and your shipping cost is always shown before you pay. Taxes depend on the state the medication ships to.

Many FSA and HSA cards are accepted, but not all; if yours does not work, pay with another card and ask your FSA or HSA company for reimbursement. Coupons and discount cards are not accepted. Your bank statement may show the charge from HealthDyne, the fulfillment partner whose pharmacies fill your order. Receipts can be viewed and downloaded from your account orders.
steps: Open the checkout email or Sign In.
Review your order and shipping cost.
Choose a saved card or add a new one.

help.title: Auto-refill
paragraphs: Auto-refill fills and ships prescriptions that have refills left without you ordering each time. In your Prescription Manager, eligible prescriptions show a button to enroll; agree to the terms and place the first order yourself, and auto-refill starts with the next scheduled refill. A payment card must be on file.

The card you used for that first order is the one charged, even if you have several cards. You get an email 7 days before each order is processed and can cancel up to then; canceling turns auto-refill off for that prescription. If a payment is declined you get an email and must order yourself with another card. To change cards, turn auto-refill off, turn it back on and place the first order with the new card.

help.title: Shipping costs
paragraphs: Standard shipping: $5.25 for 1 to 2 prescriptions, $7.50 for 3 to 4, $9.50 for 5 to 6 and $16.00 for 7 or more. Expedited shipping: $15.00 for 1 to 4 prescriptions, $20.00 for 5 to 6 and $25.00 for 7 or more; in Alaska and Hawaii expedited shipping is a flat $25. Cold-chain shipping for temperature-sensitive medication is $55 per order.
Prices are the pharmacy's cost plus a 15% markup, plus pharmacy labor and shipping. Medications cannot be returned; refunds take 5 to 10 business days to appear, depending on your bank.

help.title: Orders, receipts and cancellations
paragraphs: Sign in and open the orders page under your account to see your order history and to view or download receipts. To change or cancel an order, contact customer service right away; an order may not be stoppable once it has been placed.

To reset your password, choose Sign In, then the link for a forgotten password, and enter your email to receive a reset link. You can delete your account under Settings if you have no active items in your prescription manager.
